rows.en:
What!?
Trouble...? Are you okay, Yui?
Huh! Oh, okay... sure......

(She just blatantly changed the subject.
I wonder what that trouble was about?)

(When Yui's explanation is mostly
sound effects, I can't understand a thing...)

(Then tell me what I'm supposed to do
when it goes WHOOSH...)

(If I keep learning from Yui like this,
I don't think I'll ever understand it...)

You seem hungry too, Yui.
Why don't we stop studying here
and go grab something to eat?
Let's go, let's go!

(Well, if Yui's this happy about it,
maybe treating her is fine...)

Oh, by the way, Yui,
what was that trouble this morning, anyway?

(Geez... So it wasn't trouble after all.
Yui just overslept...)
(Honestly, Yui's always so full of it.)
(Hmm, what am I going to do...)

Oho, \p!
What's with that face, sort of troubled,
sort of not? Whatever's the matter?

Oh, Hoshimura.
Well, I couldn't understand today's EX-Gear
class at all, so I was kind of stuck...

Oh, is that all?
If that's it, I'll teach you~

Huh! Oh, yeah...
That's a really kind offer, but...

(I learned last time that I can't understand
Hoshimura's explanations...)

I'll pass this time. Your explanations are
too advanced, Hoshimura. An ordinary guy
like me could never understand them...

Aww, me, a genius far above ordinary folk...
Flattery won't get you anything~

(I didn't mean it as a compliment...
Well, if Hoshimura's happy, I guess it's fine.)

So this time, I'll try my best
to study on my own.

Ooh! What a splendid attitude!
But if you really can't figure it out,
come ask me, no holding back!
Yeah, I'll do that.
Mm, mm. So long as you understand.

Well then, I'd better be heading home.
See ya laterrr~

(For all that, Hoshimura really is kind.
If only her explanations were a little
easier to follow, it'd be perfect...)
(Hmm, what am I going to do...)

Oh, Yui.
Well, I couldn't understand today's EX-Gear
class at all, so I was kind of stuck...

(I learned last time that I can't understand
Yui's explanations...)

I'll pass this time. Your explanations are
too advanced, Yui. An ordinary girl
like me could never understand them...

(I didn't mean it as a compliment...
Well, if Yui's happy, I guess it's fine.)

So this time, I'll try my best
to study on my own.
Yeah, I'll do that.

(For all that, Yui really is kind.
If only her explanations were a little
easier to follow, it'd be perfect...)

(I promised to go shopping
with Hoshimura at Folmo, but...)
Sorry I'm laaate!!
(And Hoshimura is late again this time...)

Just to be sure, what's your excuse
for being late?
I got caught up in some morning trouble...
In other words... you overslept, right?
Yes, one could put it that way...

I'm really sorry! I'll treat you to ice cream,
so forgive me~

Forgive you? I'm not even mad,
so it's fine, really.

Uuu~, you're so sweet~
I'm absolutely smitten with your kindness~
Geez, you're so full of it...

By the way, is there anything in particular
you're after on this shopping trip?

Nope, nothing in particular.
Buying on the spur of the moment
is the Yui-san way!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders; she calls herself Yui-san.

rows.en: Makes sense. That's Hoshimura for you.
Then off to the shops, away we go~!
Yeah, yeah, away we go~!

(Haaah, I'm beat...
Seriously, Hoshimura went around
way too many shops...)
Here you go, one ice cream~

Oh, come on, did you forget?
I promised to treat you to make up
for being late, remember?
Oh, you really didn't have to...
Now, now, don't worry about it and dig in.
Thanks. Well then, don't mind if I do.

Mm, it's sweet and tasty!
Something sweet when you're tired is the best.

Is yours tasty too, then?
Then one bite for meee~!!
*Chomp!*

Mm, yummy yummy...
Truly, it is hard to say
which of the two is the more delicious.
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders (old-fashioned kouotsu tsukegatai desu naa).

rows.en:
Hey, Hoshimura!
What are you doing eating my ice cream
without asking!?

Awww, but I wanted to try it!
Sorry, sorry.
(And besides, that's an indirect...)

Well, well, we've done our shopping and had
our ice cream, so shall we call it a day?
Y-yeah...
No, it's nothing really...
You're weird~ Well then, see ya laterrr~

(Phew... Hoshimura's wild antics
surprise me every single time...)

(But it's because Hoshimura's like that
that being with her is so much fun.)

(I promised to go shopping
with Yui at Folmo, but...)
(And Yui is late again this time...)

Forgive you? I'm not even mad,
so it's fine, really.
Makes sense. That's Yui for you.

(Haaah, I'm beat...
Seriously, Yui went around
way too many shops...)
Thanks. Well then, don't mind if I do.

Mm, it's sweet and tasty!
Something sweet when you're tired is the best.

Yui...
I'm not sure it's okay to eat other people's
food without asking...
Geez, Yui...

Well, well, we've done our shopping and had
our ice cream, so let's call it a day here.
rows.notes: Hoshimura, female scene (no question mark; player replies 'Let's do that.').
